sailing: From cruising yachts and bluewater passage-makers to SailGP's foiling catamarans, this page gathers the newest sailing films from channels we trust, including Yachting Monthly, Practical Sailor, North Sails and liveaboard crews such as Sailing La Vagabonde and Sailing Uma. Expect boat tests, sail trim and seamanship tips, ocean crossings and race highlights.
powerboats: Sports cruisers, centre consoles, power catamarans and day boats: the latest powerboat reviews, sea trials and boat-show walkthroughs from Motor Boat & Yachting, BoatTEST, Boating Magazine and YachtBuyer, so you can compare hulls, engines and layouts before you visit a dealer.
flybridges: Flybridge cruisers and motor yachts from Princess, Fairline, Absolute and others, with full walkthroughs of the upper helm, saloon and cabins, sea trials and owner-style tours. Useful if you are weighing up a first flybridge or simply enjoy seeing how these boats are built and finished.
ribs: Rigid inflatable boats for tenders, diving, coastal cruising and fast fun: reviews, sea trials and handling tips from RIB Magazine, Cobra RIBs and other specialists.
jet-skis: Personal watercraft from Sea-Doo, Yamaha WaveRunner and Kawasaki Jet Ski: new model reviews, riding technique, towing and safety advice, plus Shorts from the water.
diving: Scuba diving from boats and shore, from UK wreck dives to tropical reefs: training advice from PADI, kit reviews from Scuba Diving Magazine and dive-trip films from experienced divers.
gear: Boat equipment, electronics and maintenance: chartplotters and radar from Raymarine, DIY repair and refit projects from Practical Boat Owner and BoatworksToday, and sails and rigging advice.
fishing: Boat fishing and sea angling: tactics, tackle, bait and boat set-ups from TA Fishing, BerleyPro and other angling channels, from inshore wrecks to offshore trips.
paddleboarding: Stand-up paddleboarding technique, touring and kit: tips and trips from paddleboard specialists.
beneteau: Beneteau sailing yachts and motor boats from the French builder: Oceanis, First, Antares, Swift Trawler and Gran Turismo walkthroughs, launches and boat-show tours.
jeanneau: Jeanneau sailing yachts and motor boats: Sun Odyssey, Jeanneau Yachts, Merry Fisher, Cap Camarat and NC walkthroughs, sea trials and new-model launches.
bavaria: Bavaria Yachts sailing and motor yachts from Germany: C-Line cruisers, catamarans and SR motor yachts, with launches and walkthroughs.
hallberg-rassy: Hallberg-Rassy bluewater sailing yachts from Ellös, Sweden: new models, sea trials, build quality and the yard's famous open days.
princess: Princess Yachts from Plymouth: F-Class flybridges, S-Class sports yachts, X-Class and Y-Class motor yachts, with tours and sea trials.
sunseeker: Sunseeker motor yachts from Poole: Manhattan, Predator, Ocean and superyacht models, with tours, sea trials and boat-show premieres.
fairline: Fairline motor yachts: Targa and Squadron models, with walkthroughs and sea trials.
_hub_more: Start with a section below or jump straight to a builder. Sailors will find bluewater cruising, racing and seamanship; motor-boat owners get sea trials and boat-show walkthroughs; and there is plenty for divers, anglers and jet-ski riders too. Each page has its own guide, FAQ and the newest uploads, and the whole hub refreshes itself every other day.
sailing_more: We favour videos that teach as well as entertain: sail-trim explainers, heavy-weather technique, anchoring, passage planning and honest boat tests of production cruisers from Beneteau, Jeanneau, Bavaria and Hallberg-Rassy. Grand-prix racing from SailGP sits alongside liveaboard diaries, so whether you race round the cans in the Solent or dream of the trade winds, there is something here for your next watch below.
powerboats_more: Look out for full sea trials with speed and fuel figures, engine comparisons, handling in a chop and the small details reviewers catch on deck and in the cabin. Shorts are great for a quick look at a new launch; the full-length films are where to go before a test drive or a boat show such as Southampton or Düsseldorf.
flybridges_more: Good flybridge videos show the whole boat: the stairs and helm upstairs, the galley position, guest cabins, engine room access and how she behaves at cruising speed. We filter for genuine flybridge content, so you can compare Princess F-Class with Fairline Squadron and Absolute Navetta layouts side by side.
ribs_more: Videos cover hull shapes, tubes, console layouts and engine choices, from small tenders to fast offshore RIBs.
jet-skis_more: Riders will find buyer's guides comparing models and horsepower, how-to clips on launching, docking and towing water-skiers, plus maintenance advice to keep a PWC running after salt-water use. Always check local speed limits and byelaws, especially in UK harbours, before you ride.
diving_more: Many UK dives start from a hard boat or RIB, so we include boat-diving etiquette, wreck penetration safety, drysuit tips and conservation films alongside course advice. Whether you are working towards Open Water or planning a liveaboard in the Red Sea, the newest videos are here.
gear_more: Expect hands-on reviews of chartplotters, autopilots, radar and AIS, plus practical projects: antifouling, osmosis repair, rewiring, rigging checks and winterising. It is the video companion to the Old Sea Dogs Gear section, ideal before a refit or a trip to the chandlery.
fishing_more: Videos cover rigs and lures for bass, cod, pollack and tope, reading the tide, wreck and reef marks, and fitting out a small boat for angling. Please check local size limits and catch-and-release rules before you go.
paddleboarding_more: Includes board choice, paddle technique, safety and coastal touring.
beneteau_more: Watch launches and boat-show tours of the latest Oceanis and First sailing yachts and the Antares, Flyer and Swift Trawler motor boats, plus owner-style walkthroughs that help you understand layouts and options before visiting a dealer or chartering a Beneteau in the Med.
jeanneau_more: Videos range from new Sun Odyssey launches and Jeanneau Yachts flagships to the Merry Fisher and Cap Camarat outboard boats popular on UK south-coast moorings, with sea trials, deck walkthroughs and interior tours direct from the Vendée yard.
bavaria_more: Bavaria is known for value-focused cruisers built at Giebelstadt; these videos show the C-Line's wide beam, the catamaran range and the SR motor yachts, helping you judge space and finish before buying or chartering.
hallberg-rassy_more: Few builders inspire such loyalty among long-distance sailors. Expect sea trials, interior tours that show the joinery and the windscreen-protected cockpit, and the open-yard events where the latest models are launched.
princess_more: Princess builds every yacht in Plymouth; videos show the F-Class flybridges, S-Class and X-Class models with helm-to-engine-room tours and sea trials off the Devon coast.
sunseeker_more: Built in Poole Harbour, Sunseekers star in tours, sea trials and premieres at Cannes and Southampton; this page tracks the official channels and trusted dealers, showing the newest models first.
fairline_more: Includes Targa and Squadron tours and sea trials.
